evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 若帆之阁
evidence.excerpt_zh: 北逺山村東北度石橋折而西為湛虛翠軒又西為耕雲堂又西為若帆之閣湛虛翠軒東數十武有闗帝廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按若帆之閣下層額曰御風泠然上額曰平臨天境與湛虛翠軒諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: North-east of 北逺山村 over a stone bridge and west: 湛虛翠軒, 耕雲堂, the two-storey 若帆之閣 with a plaque per floor, and a 闗帝廟 a little to the east.

evidence.title: 贾珺 on 武圣祠, the 关帝庙 of the north wall
evidence.summary: East of 湛虚翠轩 at 若帆之阁, near the north wall, in several courts: three-bay main hall in the west court, a pavilion on the south across a stream, perhaps a stage. The chief 关帝 temple of the garden, emperors came often. A small 土地庙 stood to the west and a 山神庙 in the hill bend west of the north gate (order of 1734).

evidence.title: 贾珺, 圆明三园中的祀庙祠宇建筑探析, 故宫博物院院刊 2012(3)
evidence.summary: A survey of the 33 shrines of the three gardens, with dates and forms: ancestor halls, flower god and dragon king temples, 河神庙, 关帝庙. The first thing to read for small temples with little else. Assigned here by type, not checked per temple.

evidence.title: 若帆之阁 北门 土地庙, 山神庙 (S47 section 2.8)
evidence.summary: An order of 1734 places an earth god in a small one-bay room west of the north-gate Guandi temple, and a mountain god in the fold of the hills west of the north gate. Both sit close inside the north gate of the garden.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 若帆之阁
evidence.summary: Begun 1764 within the great north gate: a square two-storey tower of three bays, 安止楼, a square half-in-water pavilion 碧澜亭, 耕云堂 on a rockery, 爽籁居, 湛虚翠轩, a stone bridge and 关帝庙. 耕云堂 survived 1860 and was lost around 1900, say the editors.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 关帝庙.
